name: 右臂原位抓取—230mm抬升—放回复位 · 正式版
description: 当前固定夹具场景：fresh ID1/Pixel Pro、cuRobo预抓取、接近闭爪、连续230mm抬升、滚动新鲜反馈验证、原路放回释放并回初始center；下一段Native准备与当前段执行重叠。2026-11-09 起按操作员要求固定为站点0.2 rad/s上限、TCP任务偏置全零、控制器工具tool_id=3（tcp3）。

contract_change_20261109.source: operator request: this demo runs at the 0.2 rad/s site ceiling, with no TCP bias, on controller tool 3 (tcp3)
contract_change_20261109.site_velocity: config/jaka_mini2_motion.site.json max_velocity_rad_s must be exactly 0.2 rad/s
contract_change_20261109.bias: task_tcp_offset_m_rad all zero AND demo_tcp_orientation_compensation.enabled=false; the 泊位 offset is read-only and unchanged
contract_change_20261109.tool: controller right-arm tool id 3; the native header carries the frozen controller tool id, never 1
contract_change_20261109.enforced: run_pick_reset_timing.py preflight BEFORE any motion writes site-ceiling.json / zero-bias.json / tool-binding.json / preflight.json and raises PREFLIGHT_FAILED without dispatching a backend STOP
contract_change_20261109.acceptance_note: the 2026-10-23 physical acceptance (tool_id=2, TCP_LOCAL_Z -10deg, 0.10 rad/s) predates this contract; the grasp and the level contract must be re-confirmed on site before this version is cited

contact_waiver_20261109.why: run console_d58281e176894dada28a0847b7614645 failed at PREPARE with CONTACT_TOOL_NON_TARGET_WORLD_COLLISION: observed_support_02_component_00_protruding_obstacle_008 after the TCP bias was cleared and the tool became tcp3 (the grasp pose moved ~25 mm in Y / ~17 mm in Z)
contact_waiver_20261109.measured: offline replay (tmp/11.9/diagnose_lift_collision.py): the 35-40% opening gripper finger base (4C2_Link1) overlaps the 7 mm-inflated AABBs of two measured support specks by 0.59 mm (25 pts, centre [0.6622,-0.2765,0.905]) and 0.13 mm (19 pts, centre [0.6623,-0.2354,0.9049]), only in the first 5 dense samples; the real gripped readback is raw 36-37 (~4%) where nothing overlaps
contact_waiver_20261109.mechanism: parameters.json:contact_extra_allowed_protrusion_waivers -> prepare_authorized_first_pick.py --contact-extra-allowed-protrusion-waivers -> the matched primitives only are added to manipulation_contact_scope.target_object_ids / motion_constraints.ignore_cuboid_ids; everything else stays hard. Anchored by body centre because support_decomposition renumbers primitives per scan
contact_waiver_20261109.precedent: same operator-approved option C waiver used by demo3 on 2026-11-06 (0.44 mm measured protrusion)
contact_waiver_20261109.verification: offline with the real continuous_demo_lift.validate_path on the frozen run: FAIL -> PASS, prefix min clearance 5.36 mm (tmp/11.9/verify_protrusion_waiver.py); NOT physically re-verified
contact_waiver_20261109.if_absent_from_a_scan: the waiver simply does not match and the collision gate fails closed again (no silent relaxation)

parameters.demo_compensation: NONE: task_tcp_offset_m_rad all zero and demo_tcp_orientation_compensation.enabled=false (zero-bias.json); old TCP_LOCAL_Z -10deg is retired
